rules: Lead with the operating problem before the framework.
Use short paragraphs and concrete nouns.
Prefer plain language over marketing jargon.

Use the manifest before referencing assets.
Use the requirements file before generating tokens or components.
Flag missing source material instead of filling gaps with assumptions.
Treat this as a public-safe demo brand.
